name: random-headgear-box
author: rhwski
description: Monsters can drop a Random Headgear Box (0.05% by default) or, with one setting, a Headgear Exchange Ticket, plus a Costume Exchange Ticket. Prontera NPCs trade tickets for headgear boxes, headgear-costume boxes and boxes from a costume collection (1,203 costumes in pre-renewal, the stock costumes in renewal), swap the two ticket kinds 1:1, and a Costume Tailor turns any headgear into costumes. The headgear boxes hold headgears nothing in the stock item database drops or sells: 417 in pre-renewal, 1,207 in renewal. Works in both eras.

settings.label: Box drop chance (units of 0.01%)
settings.description: Chance per monster kill. 5 = 0.05%, 100 = 1%, 0 = no drops.

settings.label: Monsters drop the Random Headgear Box
settings.description: On: monsters drop the Random Headgear Box. Off: they drop a Headgear Exchange Ticket instead, which the Headgear Exchange NPC in Prontera (183,190) trades for boxes.

settings.label: Drop the box on the ground
settings.description: Off: the box goes straight into your inventory. On: it drops on the ground where the monster died, like a normal drop. If your @autoloot would pick it up (its drop chance is within your @autoloot rate and its type is allowed, or it is on your @autolootitem list), it goes into your inventory anyway.

settings.label: Tickets for a Headgear Costume Box
settings.description: Headgear Exchange Tickets for a lower, middle or upper headgear costume box.

settings.label: Tickets for a one-slot Headgear Box
settings.description: Headgear Exchange Tickets for a lower, middle or upper Headgear Box (one random headgear of that slot).

settings.label: Tickets for the Random Headgear Box
settings.description: Headgear Exchange Tickets for the original Random Headgear Box (one random headgear, any slot).

settings.label: Costume Exchange Ticket drop chance (units of 0.01%)
settings.description: Chance per monster kill to drop a Costume Exchange Ticket. 5 = 0.05%, 100 = 1%, 0 = off. Tickets are spent at the Costume Exchange NPC in Prontera (185,190).

settings.label: Costume tickets for an Upper / Middle / Lower Costume Box
settings.description: Costume Exchange Tickets for a one-slot costume box from the costume collection.

settings.label: Costume tickets for a Random Costume Box
settings.description: Costume Exchange Tickets for a costume box that can hold any head slot or a garment.

settings.label: Ticket Swap: headgear tickets for 1 costume ticket
settings.description: How many Headgear Exchange Tickets the Ticket Swap NPC takes for one Costume Exchange Ticket. 1 = one for one.

settings.label: Ticket Swap: costume tickets for 1 headgear ticket
settings.description: How many Costume Exchange Tickets the Ticket Swap NPC takes for one Headgear Exchange Ticket. 1 = one for one. Raise it to make costume -> headgear more expensive.

settings.label: Costume Tailor fee (zeny)
settings.description: What the Costume Tailor (181,190) charges for turning one headgear into a costume. 0 = free.
